segments.text: Thanks for joining today. Before we look at the product, I'd love to understand how your team currently manages sales call reviews.
Honestly it's very manual. Our sales managers listen to maybe one call a week per rep, which means we're missing most of what's happening in the field.
How many reps are we talking about? And are they distributed across time zones?
We have 45 reps across North America and Europe. The manager coverage problem is even worse in EMEA because the manager is 6 hours behind.

That's a significant coaching gap. Our platform automatically flags the top three moments from every call — objections, buying signals, key questions — so managers can review in 3 minutes instead of 30.
That would be transformative for us. If managers could review 10 calls a week instead of one, we'd catch problems much earlier. What does a typical deployment look like?
Standard rollout is 3 to 4 weeks — two for setup and integration, two for manager onboarding. I'll send you our onboarding guide after this call.
